Analyzing the datasheet: one product (FTLC9555REPM3), 100GBASE-SR4. Grouping by co-occurring rows/sections only.

```json
      "host_interface_name": "4x25G electrical interface",
      "bit_rate_gbps": 25.78125,
      "reach_km": 0.1,
      "tx_power_min_dbm": -6.4,

```

**Evidence (concise):** Section V pairs **103.1 Gb/s** with **OM3 70 m (0.07 km)** and **OM4 100 m (0.1 km)** on separate rows; Section III lists **module power ≤ 2.5 W** and **CAUI-4 / 100GBASE-SR4**. Section IV **TXPx/RXPx** rows use **−8.4 / 2.4** and **−10.3 / 2.4**; **TxOMA**, **SRS (−5.2 dBm)**, and **damage threshold 3.4 dBm** belong with **25.78125 Gb/s per lane** and the **4×25G** electrical interface (Sections III–IV). **3.5 W** does not appear in this datasheet, so it is not assigned to any mode. No penalties were provided in the input.
